browser: The user's stable Google Chrome, driven through the official Claude in Chrome extension in its own tab-group window. Keys were synthetic in-page keydown/keyup events; touch buttons, Start, the language switch, menu cells on the canvas and Play again were real mouse clicks. Only visible DOM text and the drawn canvas were read; no game state was read or injected.
phoneLayouts: Checked in a same-origin 390-wide portrait frame on the page (371 px inner width, no horizontal overflow).
servedSourceCheck: The SHA-256 of all four served weightworks modules was computed in the page and matched b31102f7, 93254ea1, 36fcddcc and 47567538.

observed: A driver that reads only the Chinese status line, with a 0.35 s reaction delay and pressing an arrow or X exactly as many times as the line says, played machines 1 to 24 back to back in 4 minutes 23 seconds and reached '完成得漂亮！ 全部机器已平衡，工坊归你了！' with the maximum score of 2400. It never needed an undo, and it never had to repeat an action.
English machine select listed all 24 machines; one tap on machine 5 selected it and a second tap entered it.

English: spending machine 5's five moves by placing and lifting a mass in place showed 'Too few moves left: press Z to undo' from the third move. Without an undo the run ended 6.5 s after the last move with 'Out of moves on machine 5. Try it again.' Z, arrows, X, Space and Q on the loss screen changed nothing, and Play again returned to machine select.
English phone frame: real taps on the touch buttons alone, following the prompt, cleared machines 1 and 2. On machine 2 the Undo button took back a placement and Reset restored the machine.
At 371 px the host header clips the end of the prompt; the full prompt stays on the canvas.

limitations: Physical phones, other browsers, tapping pegs on the canvas and audio were not tested; the loss countdown was not photographed; console output was not captured.
